tasks.doneWhen: A draft PR gets a result from each job.

tasks.title: M0-BE-03 Supabase
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Local config, auth settings, Mailpit, Resend SMTP block.
tasks.doneWhen: supabase start and db reset work from zero.

tasks.title: M0-BE-04 Environment
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. lib/env.ts with Zod, .env.example, publishable key with anon-key fallback, EMAIL_DELIVERY=resend required in production, build and boot checks (see docs/STAGING.md).
tasks.doneWhen: A bad variable fails with its name and never its value.

tasks.title: M0-BE-05 Identity tables
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. profiles (synced from auth.users), platform_admins (service role only), platform_settings (deny by default), audit_logs. Follow PLAN §2 database rules.
tasks.doneWhen: A client can't write admin, settings or audit rows.

tasks.title: M0-BE-06 Tenancy tables
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. organizations (unique slug 3-40 chars, status, currency, timezone), reserved_slugs, locations (address, timezone, currency, tax and service-charge bps, tax-on-service flag), org_branding (https-only logo URL).
tasks.doneWhen: Constraints and RLS are in place.

tasks.title: M0-BE-07 Packages
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. packages (prices, trial days, limits, features, active, public, default) and subscriptions.
tasks.doneWhen: One default package gives a new restaurant a trial.

tasks.title: M0-BE-08 Roles
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. permissions, default_role_permissions, roles, role_permissions, organization_members, location_staff, seeded from PLAN §4.2.1 catalog.
tasks.doneWhen: The five system roles match the §4.2.1 table.

tasks.title: M0-BE-09 Invitations
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. staff_invitations with SHA-256 token hash, capped expiry, accepted and revoked times, explicit all-locations flag.
tasks.doneWhen: No raw token is stored.

tasks.title: M0-BE-10 Helpers
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. is_platform_admin, is_org_member, has_permission (fails closed), has_location_access, my_permissions, get_org_package, my_org_membership, private.org_limit, private.write_audit.
tasks.doneWhen: A suspended org or deactivated member gets no access.

tasks.title: M0-BE-11 Guards
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Triggers for plan limits (PLAN_LIMIT:<key>), last owner, system-role protection, no self-escalation, no member delete, updated_at, audit.
tasks.doneWhen: Each forbidden write fails in the database.

tasks.title: M0-BE-12 RPCs
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. is_slug_available, create_organization (one transaction, per-user cap), accept_invitation (email must match), set_member_locations (atomic), get_storefront.
tasks.doneWhen: A failure leaves no partial rows.

tasks.title: M0-BE-13 Seeds and types
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Local seed (three packages, Demo Restaurant with two locations, a second tenant, one user per role, platform admin), staging seed without users (supabase/seed-staging.sql), packages/db generated types.
tasks.doneWhen: A reset gives the same data each time.

tasks.title: M0-BE-14 Clients and proxy
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Supabase server, browser, proxy and server-only admin clients. proxy.ts resolves hosts, refreshes sessions, skips the DOKU webhook and serves Vercel preview hosts (STAGING.md).
tasks.doneWhen: An unknown host returns 404 and preview URLs open.

tasks.title: M0-BE-15 Auth access layer
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. getCurrentUser, requireUser, getMembership, getOrgContext, requirePermission, requirePlatformAdmin, hasFeature.
tasks.doneWhen: All server code has one way to check access.

tasks.title: M0-BE-16 Abuse protection
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Arcjet shield, bot detection, rate limits and a signup preset. Use the arcjet skill.
tasks.doneWhen: Repeated auth attempts are limited.

tasks.title: M0-BE-17 Analytics and errors
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. PostHog capture, typed events, org grouping, error tracking, allow-listed query parameters, masked tokens, autocapture and recording off. Use the PostHog skills.
tasks.doneWhen: No token or personal field leaves the app.

tasks.title: M0-BE-18 Email sender
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Resend wrapper with one recipient, idempotency key, log mode locally, failures logged and retryable.
tasks.doneWhen: A failed send can be retried without a duplicate.

tasks.title: M0-BE-19 Money
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Formatting (Rp 25.000), tax and service-charge calculation in basis points, integers only.
tasks.doneWhen: Rounding has unit tests.

tasks.title: M0-BE-20 Auth actions
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Login, signup, confirm by token hash, forgot and reset password, sign out, safe next redirect.
tasks.doneWhen: All return one ActionResult shape and signed-in users skip the auth pages.

tasks.title: M0-BE-21 Create restaurant
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Slug check and create action on the create_organization RPC.
tasks.doneWhen: The user lands in their organization as Owner.

tasks.title: M0-BE-22 Staff actions
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Invite, resend, revoke, accept, change role, set locations, deactivate with sign-out everywhere.
tasks.doneWhen: Every action is permission-checked and audited.

tasks.title: M0-BE-23 Custom roles
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Create, edit and delete roles from the permission list, gated by package.
tasks.doneWhen: Nobody can grant a permission they lack.

tasks.title: M0-BE-24 Staging delivery
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Vercel build and the Deploy DB (staging) workflow described in docs/STAGING.md. Applies only after merge.
tasks.doneWhen: The workflow's dry run passes.

tasks.title: M0-BE-25 Contracts
tasks.description: Owner ADIT. Contracts for auth, organization, staff, roles in docs/contracts/. Required before backend handoff.
tasks.doneWhen: Each contract lists inputs, outputs, errors and permissions.

tasks.title: M0-FE-01 Theme
tasks.description: Owner REYKI (starts only after backend handoff). Tokens from DESIGN.md §10, 60-30-10 theme map, Plus Jakarta Sans.
tasks.doneWhen: Changing the map re-themes the app with no component edit.

tasks.title: M0-FE-02 Base components
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Buttons, fields, cards, badges, tabs, tables, modal, sheet, toast, skeleton, empty, error, offline bar.
tasks.doneWhen: Each has every state in DESIGN.md §6 and works by keyboard.

tasks.title: M0-FE-03 Translations
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. English and Bahasa Indonesia, language switch, number and date formats.
tasks.doneWhen: No screen has hard-coded text.

tasks.title: M0-FE-04 Auth screens
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Login, signup, check email, forgot, reset, invalid link.
tasks.doneWhen: Errors keep the user's input.

tasks.title: M0-FE-05 Create restaurant
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Name, live slug check, first location with tax and service defaults.
tasks.doneWhen: It ends on the restaurant dashboard.

tasks.title: M0-FE-06 Admin shell
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Sidebar from permissions, location switcher, no-access and global error pages.
tasks.doneWhen: Each role sees only its navigation.

tasks.title: M0-FE-07 Staff screens
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Members, pending invites, invite form, role and location edit, deactivate, accept page.
tasks.doneWhen: A bad invite link always shows the same generic page.

tasks.title: M0-FE-08 Role editor
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Permission checklist, system roles read-only, locked state by package.
tasks.doneWhen: An owner can create and assign a role.

tasks.title: M0-FE-09 Public and platform shells
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Marketing layout, guarded super admin layout with its dark sidebar, storefront placeholder and suspended notice.
tasks.doneWhen: Each surface opens on its own route.

tasks.title: M0-FE-10 Emails
tasks.description: Owner REYKI. Confirmation, recovery and staff invitation templates in the Restomate theme.
tasks.doneWhen: Links use token_hash and render in Mailpit.

tasks.title: M0-QA-01 Test base
tasks.description: Owner DAVIN (starts only after frontend handoff). Test plan, bug and report templates, pgTAP and Playwright setup.
tasks.doneWhen: Both suites run in CI.

tasks.title: M0-QA-02 Isolation
tasks.description: Owner DAVIN. Select, insert, update and delete across two tenants on every table.
tasks.doneWhen: Every cross-tenant attempt fails.

tasks.title: M0-QA-03 Abuse
tasks.description: Owner DAVIN. Escalation, last owner, limits, reused, expired and wrong-email invites, slug rules, rate limit.
tasks.doneWhen: Each is refused.

tasks.title: M0-QA-04 End to end
tasks.description: Owner DAVIN. Signup, confirm, create restaurant, invite Cashier, accept, deactivate.
tasks.doneWhen: The exit passes on desktop and tablet.

tasks.title: M0-QA-05 Sign-off
tasks.description: Owner DAVIN. Write docs/qa/M0-signoff.md with evidence for each M0 acceptance line (4.9.1, 4.9.2, 4.9.3, 4.9.6) and PASS/FAIL verdict.
tasks.doneWhen: docs/qa/M0-signoff.md gives evidence for each acceptance line.
